source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of teamwork and knowledge sharing (PDF 190).

blocks.text: Teamwork aur ilm ki sharing ka matlab group projects mein har rukn ka apni maharat dena, maslan science project mein tehqeeqi nataij share karna, aur samajh barhane ke liye study groups ya mubahison mein khayalat ka tabadla hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek digital auzaar bataiye jo team ko ilm share karne mein madad de.
blocks.explanation: Mushtarak document ya drive (jaise Google Docs) jahan sab tehqeeq jor aur badal sakein.

items: Teamwork: har koi hissa dalta aur seekha hua share karta hai.
